name: ali_cbct
description: Automated Anatomic Landmarks Identification on CBCT scans using AI agents. Detects anatomical reference points on cone-beam CT volumes for precise dental and maxillofacial measurements and analysis.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: CBCT files (.nii/.nrrd/...) or folder containing the scans.

parameters.name: lm_type
parameters.description: List of landmark types to detect, separated by comma (no brackets).

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Output folder where landmarks are saved

parameters.name: DCMInput
parameters.description: Whether input is DICOM format (true) or not (false)

examples: ali cbct on DICOM folder : "./patient01_dcm/" "models/" "LM1,LM2" "./out" "./tmp" true "[0.6,0.3]" "[1,1]" "[64,64,64]" 10
